answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock a bond for 30 days before bidding on jobs, whether supplying a lantern, mixing ivory paint, or repairing a bridge. Each bond supports only one active bid, so creating extra identities does not create extra bidding capacity for free. An attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous bids must fund 1,000 bonds and leave that capital inaccessible for the full lockup, even if the bids fail.
